title: Failed UPI payments and debited amounts - support procedure
content: For the fictional bank, note failed or pending status, approximate amount and date, then check the synthetic transaction history after verification. If the receiving party disputes receipt, an agent reviews the reference; refunds and timelines are not guaranteed.
